mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT node_id AS nodeId, is_affirm AS isAffirm, node_type AS nodeType, warning_val_one AS warningValOne, warning_val_two AS warningValTwo, warning_val_three AS warningValThree, warning_type AS warningType, warning_grade AS warningGrade, warning_time_one AS warningTimeOne, warning_time_two AS warningTimeTwo, warning_time_three AS warningTimeThree FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{earlyWarning.warningType} and warning_grade = #{earlyWarning.warningGrade} AND is_affirm = #{earlyWarning.affirm} LIMIT 1) t
